mq-4AF8.title: Coverage: dark humid garden, ferns and bamboo
mq-4AF8.summary: The most tropical, humid and dark trekker, with buttress-root trees, ferns and bamboo. A man in a black shirt and grey cap is sometimes seen.

mq-BEOL.title: Coverage: rum distillery trekker
mq-BEOL.summary: A trekker covers a rum distillery, with a warehouse, truck and forklift, an outdoor view with hills and machines, a red-soil dirt track with palms, and an inside built from H-beam steel.

mq-gRbW.title: Coverage: three Gen 3 trekkers, island
mq-gRbW.summary: A French overseas island between Dominica and St Lucia, counted as France for streaks. Only three older Gen 3 trekkers, so memorise what they look like.

mq-vcqO.title: Coverage: coastal trekker, orange roofs
mq-vcqO.summary: A southern coastal trekker starts on a hilly path with other people, passes houses with orange roofs and a flat open path with the sea visible through trees, and ends at a car park with stalls.
